propositions: Prevent closing a task/story/epic when its own plan or a pinned upstream plan changed during execution, without requiring plan review inside close or invalidating all implementations for file changes

Add a configurable gate that runs plan validity checks before close completion, accepting certified reviews that are material-current and phase-compatible despite code drift, while always blocking unsigned/reopened/stale-registry/malformed-metadata tickets

Implement a generic pre_status_check callback in txn.transition_core that runs under the existing write lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, allowing close policy to catch plan/signature/phase/material/pin changes between precheck and lock without double-locking

Ensure the close gate performs zero LLM/model/network calls, fails closed on unexpected exceptions as verdict unavailable, and returns exact verdict-prefixed error messages directing users to run separate review-plan remediation

Bypass both completion verification and the plan-review gate only for non-empty force-close reasons, and preserve existing exemptions for bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, and idea-to-closed transitions
